item.title: [New] Auto-expanding archive mailboxes can grow to 3 TB instead of 1.5 TB for eligible licences (GCC, GCC High and DoD, mid-November to early December)
item.description:
Larger archives mean larger eDiscovery and content-search scopes during an investigation; storage is not a security control but it changes how long a search over a held mailbox takes.

Purview · Awareness only; update eDiscovery runbooks that assume a 1.5 TB ceiling.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1521615 Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management increases the auto-expanding archive limit from 1.5 TB to 3 TB
item.description:
Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management increases the auto-expanding archive limit for eligible Exchange Online mailboxes from 1.5 TB to 3 TB, starting mid-November 2026. No additional configuration or charges are required; organizations should review licenses and monitor mailbox growth accordingly.

Microsoft Purview · planForChange

item.title: [New] Purview eDiscovery adds three read-only diagnostics for case access, security filters and hold-policy distribution
item.description:
During an investigation the usual eDiscovery failure is a case nobody can open or a hold that did not reach a mailbox; a built-in check shortens that triage without changing any setting.

Purview · Point the investigators who run eDiscovery cases at the new diagnostics once they appear; nothing to configure.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Message Center] MC1515937 Microsoft Purview | eDiscovery: In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
item.description:
Microsoft Purview eDiscovery introduces three read-only diagnostics for case access, security filters, and hold-policy distribution to help admins troubleshoot issues. Rolling out from October 2026 to February 2027 across environments. No admin action required; diagnostics do not alter configurations.

Microsoft Purview · stayInformed
